principle: Build PROGRAMMING_KB in source-authority order: regional legal/normative truth first, primary language authority second, scientific/professional evidence next, books as explanatory/practice material, then world production evidence. Training is downstream of all required MIN layers.

layers.purpose: Determine mandatory, conditional, contractual, voluntary, current, superseded and future-effective obligations before technical choices are recommended.
layers.rule: A current GOST is not automatically mandatory; applicability is a separate reviewed edge. Exact legal/normative truth is resolved through the Global Document Registry and official evidence.

layers.purpose: Describe language semantics, standard library/runtime behavior, official idioms and version-sensitive constraints from the language/project maintainers or standards body.

targets.name: C# standard specification and feature specifications
ISO C++ standard / WG21 authority
targets.rights_gate: Exact published ISO standard text may require an authorized copy.

targets.name: ISO C standard / WG14 authority
targets.rights_gate: Exact published ISO standard text may require an authorized copy.

layers.rule: Community guidance and books may explain a language but cannot override its primary specification, current implementation documentation or measured project evidence.

layers.purpose: Provide correctness, complexity, software engineering and security foundations for choices rather than folklore.
layers.rule: Algorithm and engineering choices are represented as conditional rules with preconditions, counterexamples and evidence, not as globally best solutions.

layers.purpose: Add worked examples, pedagogy, alternative explanations and implementation patterns after primary/consensus anchors exist.
layers.rule: A Telegram match proves discoverability, not rights or technical truth. Commercial full text requires an owned/authorized copy before ingestion.

layers.purpose: Validate how recommendations behave in production through reputable engineering guides, benchmarks, incident evidence and reproducible measurements.
future_targets: OpenSSF/CNCF supply-chain and platform practices where applicable
layers.rule: Production evidence can refine technical recommendations but cannot override applicable law or a primary language specification.

layers.purpose: Test whether the agent can apply already-reviewed knowledge nodes and relations.
layers.rule: Tasks are downstream evaluation artifacts. They never create normative or technical truth by themselves.

completion_rule: PROGRAMMING_KB_MIN_READY may be true only when required layers L1-L5 have reviewable evidence, explicit coverage metrics and no unresolved NECESSARY gap that blocks the requested RU profile.
